expected.sql: SELECT g.party_code || '|' || COALESCE(g.bl_no,'') || '|' || COALESCE(g.payer_company_code,'') || '|' || COALESCE(g.currency,'') AS match_ref, g.party_code, g.supplier_company_code, g.supplier_name, g.payer_company_code, g.bl_no, g.bill_month, g.expected_amount, g.currency FROM (SELECT COALESCE(fsb.supplier_company_code, fsb.supplier) AS party_code, MAX(fsb.supplier_company_code) AS supplier_company_code, MAX(fsb.supplier) AS supplier_name, fsb.payer_company_code, fsb.bl_no, fsb.bill_month, SUM(fsb.amount) AS expected_amount, COALESCE(fsb.currency_norm, fsb.currency) AS currency FROM freight_supplier_bills fsb WHERE fsb.bill_month >= substring($1::text, 1, 7) AND fsb.bill_month < substring($2::text, 1, 7) GROUP BY COALESCE(fsb.supplier_company_code, fsb.supplier), fsb.payer_company_code, fsb.bl_no, fsb.bill_month, COALESCE(fsb.currency_norm, fsb.currency)) g ORDER BY 1

actual.sql: SELECT fii.id AS invoice_id, fii.invoice_no, fii.issue_date, fii.seller_name, fii.seller_company_code, fii.buyer_company_code, fii.amount_incl_tax AS actual_amount, fii.currency, fii.review_status, bl.bl_no, COALESCE(fii.seller_company_code, fii.seller_name) || '|' || bl.bl_no || '|' || COALESCE(fii.buyer_company_code,'') || '|' || COALESCE(fii.currency,'') AS match_ref FROM finance_invoices_in fii CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(fii.customs_nos) AS bl(bl_no) WHERE COALESCE(fii.void_status,'') NOT IN ('void','red_ink','cancelled','作废','已作废')
